name: fieldproof-default-action-tiers
description: Reference policy from the Fieldproof Agentic AI Governance Pack: four action tiers, default-deny, money and deletion gated to humans.

rules.rationale: Reads are tier 0: no side effects.
Listing vault names is not a secret read.
Read-only domain inventory is separate from DNS or website writes.
Write a secret into KeePass or the OS store. The value never enters the mesh.
Invoke a secret by opaque reference. The agent never sees the value.
Approved connectors may be invoked. Fail closed on revoke, expiry, or missing scope.
DNS writes need capability, scope, diff, and verification. Separate from website writes.
Service accounts created for the mesh are for the mesh to operate.
Secret values must never be retrieved into the mesh.
Secret values must never appear in prompts, logs, files, or receipts.
Any outbound payment is at least tier 2; small ones may be approved quickly.
Payments over $50 are outside agent authority entirely.
Payment with unspecified amount: treat as worst case.
Raw credential values stay out of the mesh. Opaque vault and connector use is a different action family.
Content edits are versioned and reversible.
First contact with a new party is new-in-kind: stage for human approval.
